# gyro Provider

Manage Gyro (gyrohosting.com) cloud servers, SSH keys, mail, object storage, DNS records and more through the Gyro Public API. Servers are chosen by plan (e.g. standart-2-4) and region (e.g. eu-de-1).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    gyro = {
      source  = "gyro-hosting/gyro"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

# Reads GYRO_TOKEN (client API key, wck_...) from the environment.
provider "gyro" {}

# Another account you are a panel user of (Sub-Accounts), with your own key (Gyro Public API 2.46.0).
# Permissions are the panel user permissions; list the ids with `gyro account list`.
provider "gyro" {
  alias      = "client"
  account_id = 12345
}
```

## Limits

Every account has limits (servers, batch size, paid API operations per day, SSH keys, firewall rules, storage buckets, DNS zones, container plan limits and more).
New accounts can run at most 5 Gyro Cloud Istanbul servers and 1 container environment during their first 7 days.
Read them with the [`gyro_account_limits`](data-sources/account_limits.md) data source (`GET /cloud/account/limits`, `gyro limits`).

**Account limits are raised with a support ticket**: `POST /api/v1/client/tickets` (department 3) or
`gyro ticket create --department-id 3 --subject "Limit increase: <limit_key>" --message "<requested limit and reason>"`.
When an apply is refused because of a limit, the error names the limit, the current value and usage, and prints the ready ticket command.

## Schema

### Optional

- `account_id` (Number) Manage another account with your own key (Gyro Public API 2.46.0): the id of an account whose owner added you as a panel user (Sub-Accounts; list them with `gyro account list` or GET /accounts). Every request is sent with X-Account-Id and is allowed exactly what the panel allows that user (owner-only resources such as API keys, webhooks and reseller customers are refused). Omit for your own account. Deliberately NOT read from the environment or the CLI profile: a state belongs to one account, changing account_id makes existing resources look deleted (planned for re-creation). Use provider aliases for several accounts.
- `endpoint` (String) API base URL. Defaults to $GYRO_ENDPOINT or https://www.gyrohosting.com/api/v1/client.
- `poll_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between status polls (default 5).
- `poll_timeout_minutes` (Number) Maximum minutes to wait for a server to become ready (default 15).
- `profile` (String) gyro CLI profile to take the API key (and API URL) from when token and $GYRO_TOKEN are not set: ~/.config/gyro/config.toml ($GYRO_CONFIG_FILE / $XDG_CONFIG_HOME respected); a profile saved with token_storage = "keyring" is read from the OS key store (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Linux Secret Service). Defaults to $GYRO_PROFILE, then the CLI default profile. Order: token > $GYRO_TOKEN > profile. Create one with `gyro auth login` or `gyro configure`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Client API key (wck_...). Defaults to $GYRO_TOKEN, then to the gyro CLI profile (see profile). Needs Module:Addons/GyroAPI/cloud_read and, for writes, cloud_write / cloud_order / cloud_delete.
